name: Action in the Gulf of Sidra (1986)
source_ini: Action in the Gulf of Sidra 1986.ini

0.objective:
As part of Operation ATTAIN DOCUMENT III, U.S. forces have crossed Moammar Gaddafi's "Line of Death", entering the Gulf of Sidra. Shortly thereafter, Libyan SAMs were fired at two American F-14 Tomcats. U.S. forces have been ordered to destroy the SAM site at Sirte in response, and guard against any Libyan counterattack at sea or in the air.

MISSION BRIEFING:
U.S. forces crossed Gaddafi's "Line of Death" this morning, and two of our Tomcats were fired on by the Libyan SAM battery at Sirte. COMSIXTHFLT has just activated Operation PRAIRIE FIRE, ordering the U.S. forces in the area to destroy the SAM battery and eliminate any Libyan air/naval counterattack.

There is heavy civilian traffic in the area and civilian casualties must be avoided.

All of your ships must survive.

OBJECTIVES:
- Destroy the SA-5 radar at Sirte
- All of your ships must survive
- Destroy any Libyan naval attack
0.roe: You are cleared to engage forces that are identified as hostile. Never fire on Neutral or civilian vessels; avoid civilian casualties. Keep your own units alive: losses count against you.
